I have been farming here in Ntchisi for many years, and I know that beans do not need chemical fertilizer because they fix nitrogen from the air—besides, fertilizer is too expensive and hard to find. I will spread manure from my cattle on this plot to keep the soil strong, and I will plant seed that I saved from last season's harvest because it has always done well here. My family will manage all the work since the plot is small, and I will rely on the rains like we always do because there is no irrigation water nearby.
